description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Upload' model class within the OpenCart admin system, providing methods for adding, deleting, retrieving, and listing upload entries in the database.

classes.name: Upload
classes.description: Handles upload-related database operations such as CRUD functions.

methods.name: addUpload
methods.description: Inserts a new upload record into the database and returns its associated code.

methods.name: deleteUpload
methods.description: Deletes an upload record from the database based on its ID.

methods.name: getUpload
methods.description: Retrieves a specific upload record by its ID.

methods.name: getUploadByCode
methods.description: Fetches an upload record by its unique code.

methods.name: getUploads
methods.description: Retrieves a list of uploads with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalUploads
methods.description: Returns the total count of upload records that match given filters.
